purpose: Apply the previously verified original KITTI 2D matching core to completed immutable prediction archives. This native difficulty/AP_R40 endpoint is separate from both common COCO AP variants, which remain mandatory.
core_provenance: Reuse the checksum-pinned original developer-kit source, local 2D path/count harness, executable, build manifest and eight-case synthetic proof from the prior completed phase. No rebuild, changes to matching/ignore/IoU/difficulty rules, or repeat of the eight original tests. The new integration is separately tested with fabricated records.
request_schema: native_kitti_archive_scoring_request_v1: archive_path, archive_manifest_sha256, archive_complete_sha256, source_sha256 for the three fixed modules, native_core_paths for executable/original_source/adapted_source/build_manifest/prior_synthetic_proof, and label_zip with path/SHA256.
integrity: Require a complete archive and verify every record, source and native-core hash. Require ZIP member names to exactly cover the complete image population; duplicate/extra/missing members fail. Copy each label member byte-for-byte into a fresh private stage. The original ZIP and existing extracted data are read-only. Verify hashes before/after scoring, verify local label and prediction snapshots, and save all file hashes. Actual final requests must use the production hashes above and the final frozen48endpoint roster.
export: One text file for every frame, including empty predictions. Map person0 to Pedestrian and car2 to Car only after the original all-ten-class NMS. Retain zero-area predictions and use the unchanged nine-significant-digit float32-safe serializer. Save counts, input bindings, native text files, complete precision curves and all per-class/difficulty results.
metric: Original 2D class/difficulty matching: Car IoU>0.7 and Pedestrian IoU>0.5, with the original height/truncation/occlusion/neighbor/DontCare behavior. Parse exactly3by41 finite precision values per class. AP_R40 is the mean of slots1 through40 excluding slot0, reported as a fraction. Primary native summary is the arithmetic mean of Car and Pedestrian moderate AP_R40; all easy/moderate/hard values remain reported.
completion: Exclusive output lock, subprocess argument list with no shell, fresh partial directory and atomic final directory commit. Preserve partial artifacts on failure. Never mark complete after a failed native process. Existing matching complete outputs are hash-verified and reused without invoking the binary; changed inputs or outputs fail.
synthetic_integration: 400 fabricated frames: half have missing predictions; the others have true positives, high-score DontCare overlaps, non-target-class outputs and collapsed outputs. Both classes/all difficulties give known-answer AP_R40=0.5. All1400raw outputs remain archived;1200mapped outputs,200empty files and400collapsed mapped outputs are exported. This is a software fixture, not scientific detector performance. A planned process-failure mock verifies incomplete-state retention; a no-execution mock verifies complete-state reuse. Source/label/export mutations and malformed/nonfinite curves are rejected.
data_handling: Private score folders include copies of original labels and native prediction files. Do not automatically publish these folders or ZIPs. The public allowlist here contains only original wrapper/test code, aggregate evidence and this policy.
limits: This is a local evaluation on the previously examined publicly labeled KITTI training partition, not the official hidden-test benchmark or an untouched new test set. GPU inference preflight, native BDD final-run integration, final training/input/checkpoint audits, the48endpoint roster and all actual evaluations/scientific analysis remain pending. Synthetic proof does not establish generalization or explain dataset effects.
